mapper.update: UPDATE sys_file_relation SET status='RELEASED',released_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND status='ACTIVE'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_file_relation WHERE file_id=#{fileId} AND status='ACTIVE'

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_file_relation relation JOIN learn_task_checkin checkin ON checkin.id=relation.business_id JOIN learn_task_assignment assignment ON assignment.id=checkin.assignment_id WHERE relation.file_id=#{fileId} AND relation.module_code='LEARNING_TASK_CHECKIN' AND relation.relation_type='IMAGE' AND relation.status='ACTIVE' AND assignment.current_reviewer_id=#{userId}

SELECT file.id,file.storage_key,file.original_name,file.extension,file.content_type,file.size_bytes, file.uploader_id,file.module_code,file.file_category,file.content_sha256,file.status, file.uploaded_at,file.created_at,file.updated_at FROM sys_file_relation relation JOIN sys_file file ON file.id=relation.file_id WHERE relation.module_code=#{moduleCode} AND relation.business_id=#{businessId} AND relation.relation_type=#{relationType} AND relation.status='ACTIVE' AND file.status='AVAILABLE' ORDER BY relation.created_at, relation.id
